actualPublicEvidence.independentManualResult: Actual public profile login, list, two fresh uses, expiry refresh to added-rotated and fresh reload passed. Root auth/.env/singleton digests stayed unchanged during these phases.

pinnedPublicDiscoveryContract.fact: auth list anthropic filters the provider, then calls load_pool and lists its entries. The filter is not a provider-configuration or consent signal.
Anthropic singleton discovery returns before reading any singleton when is_provider_explicitly_configured(anthropic) is false.

Explicit configuration can come from active_provider, actual model/auxiliary/MoA configuration, a usable explicit env credential or an existing explicitly added pool row. Singleton existence and a list-command filter do not qualify by themselves.
Anthropic public auth-add creates manual:hermes_pkce and leaves activate_first at false. Unlike first Codex/xAI adds, it does not activate the provider.
The reader uses active HERMES_HOME/.anthropic_oauth.json, accepts accessToken, and the seeder transfers accessToken/refreshToken/expiresAt into its own genuine hermes_pkce pool row.
The seeded label comes from token identity claims or the hermes_pkce fallback. The original manually chosen pool label is not carried by the singleton schema.
